title: Mean of a nontrivial Fourier character vanishes
statement:
Fix a modulus $k \ge 1$ and a dimension $n$, and let $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i/k}$. For a frequency $s \in \bbz_k^n$, let $\chi_s(x) = \omega_k^{s\cdot x}$ be the associated Fourier character on $\bbz_k^n$. If $s \neq 0$, then the character has vanishing mean:
\[
  \E[\chi_s] = \frac{1}{k^n}\sum_{x \in \bbz_k^n} \omega_k^{s\cdot x} = 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: s is a nonzero frequency vector in Z_k^n
